first_comment: Bonus: there's no road to the Muttsee dam, so every panel and even a dismantled crane were flown up by helicopter. Would you visit? 🏔️

stories.stat_label: of its power made in winter
stories.headline: Solar panels on an Alpine dam make 43% of their power in winter
stories.summary: 4,872 panels hang on the Muttsee dam about 2,500 m up. In its first measured year the plant made 43% of its power in the winter half, 3.8 times a lowland plant's winter output.
stories.why: Mountain solar fills Switzerland's winter power gap, when it's needed most.

stories.headline: Somalia cut cholera deaths by 93%
stories.summary: The WHO's Eastern Mediterranean office says Somalia cut cholera deaths by 93% and re-established a national medicines regulator after more than 30 years.
stories.why: Fewer families losing loved ones to a disease that is fully preventable.

stories.headline: Mohenjo-daro grew fairer as it grew bigger, homes reveal
stories.summary: Comparing house sizes at the Indus city, researchers found inequality fell over time as homes lined up with its planned streets, hinting that shared public works kept wealth gaps small.
stories.why: Growing cities don't have to mean growing gaps between rich and poor.

stories.stat_label: of shelter pets saved for a year
stories.headline: Wyoming became the 6th US state where every shelter is no-kill
stories.summary: Every Wyoming shelter saved at least 90% of its pets for 12 straight months, 92% overall, Best Friends Animal Society says. A rescue taking in sick cats and kittens helped close the gap.
stories.why: Rural communities proved every healthy or treatable pet can be saved.

fun_fact: The Muttsee panels are tilted at 51 or 65 degrees so snow slides off them.
